items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: he says, Bud Johnson and Keg Johnson, two brothers. I said, well, send them on down here.

ctx.x: While I was getting the band together, somebody told me, says, there's two boys in Chicago here, say, you ought to get them, Randolph. Say, they are good, says. I said, what's their name? And he says, Bud Johnson and Keg Johnson, two brothers. I said, well, send them on down here. Tell them to come down to the Appomatox. We were rehearsing down there. That was down on South Parkway.
